summary: Come to tizi town, Play with little princesses & enjoy living in a wonder world.
description:
Enter the world of little princesses & pretend to play in the huge princess castle. Are you ready for the best royal castle life? Then start your royal princess castle adventure in town right away!

The little princess castle is huge & there are loads of rooms to explore. Join us in this fantasy world where you have no boundaries to your imagination. Pick your favorite princess and make a wonderful story with your creativity.

THINGS YOU CAN ENJOY IN THIS PRINCESS APP ARE: 

👑 Play Princess Games
You can create your very own original princess story in this unique castle. You can even dress up every little princess in this game. Choose cute dresses and show off your fashion sense in these princess games. Give each other a cute makeover!

👑 Princess Throne Room
Make the characters sit on shiny thrones and have a royal discussion. Eat yummy food and talk about the happenings of the town. Explore every corner of this room to find hidden secrets!

👑 Princess Kitchen
Whenever your princess is hungry, just head over to the kitchen and get some munchies. Feed yummy food to the characters and prepare some more food for later! There are lots of usable items here. There's always something delicious being prepared in this royal kitchen!

👑 Princess Bedroom
Develop your storytelling skills by playing pretend. In the princess bedroom, you can check out the wonderfully designed room filled with awesome items. Help your princess get ready in your dollhouse. Be a princess stylist and show off your skills!

👑 Princess Magical Garden 
Go on a picnic with your princesses & princes. Enjoy the outdoors with some royal friends. 

It's such a beautiful world perfect for boys and girls who love cute princesses! You will spend endless hours having fun in this town. Don't miss out on this experience and download this app NOW!
